title: 阿达帕错失生命之食
summary: 阿达帕折断南风的翅膀，被召到天神面前。埃阿告诫他不要吃喝天上的食物，他依言拒绝，却错过神明提供的生命之食；智慧与服从没有使凡人获得永生。
paragraphs: 阿达帕是埃里都侍奉埃阿的智者，拥有非凡知识，却没有永恒生命。一次他出海捕鱼，南风把船吹翻，他愤而诅咒，折断南风的翅膀，使风连续多日不能吹动。天神阿努察觉异常，追问原因，命人召来这位敢于伤害风的凡人，阿达帕因此必须离开日常祭祀之地接受询问。
埃阿先教他怎样应对：穿上丧服，在天门前为杜穆兹与宁吉什兹达哀悼，争取两位神的好感。他又警告，若有人给他死亡之食与死亡之水，绝对不要接受，却可以使用衣服与油。阿达帕照着指示进入天庭，门神替他说话，阿努听过解释后，反而命人拿来生命之食和水。
阿达帕牢记告诫，拒绝进食饮水，却接受衣服并涂上油。阿努追问他为何不吃，得知这是埃阿的叮嘱，便让他返回地上，生命的机会已被错过。现存传本有残缺与差异，埃阿为何如此告诫也存在解释争论；不能额外编出他承认蓄意欺骗的对白，来替这个含混结局定案。

en.title: Adapa Refuses the Food of Life
en.summary: After disabling the South Wind, Adapa must answer to Anu in heaven. Ea prepares him for the encounter and warns him against heavenly food. His faithful refusal nevertheless passes over an offer of life, leaving wisdom unable to secure immortality.
paragraphs: Adapa serves Ea at Eridu and possesses exceptional understanding, but not everlasting life. While he is fishing at sea, the South Wind overturns his boat. In anger, he breaks the wind’s wings, preventing it from blowing for several days. Anu notices the disturbance and summons the mortal responsible. The wise attendant must now explain himself before the ruler of heaven.

Ea tells Adapa to wear mourning clothes and lament Dumuzi and Ningishzida at heaven’s gate, winning their support. He also warns him not to consume the food and water of death, although clothing and oil may be accepted. Adapa follows these instructions. The gatekeepers speak favorably for him, and Anu, after hearing the case, orders food and water of life instead.

Remembering Ea’s warning, Adapa refuses to eat or drink, while accepting clothing and anointing himself with oil. Asked why, he names his teacher’s instructions. Anu sends him back to earth, the opportunity lost. Surviving witnesses are incomplete and differ; Ea’s purpose remains debated. The narrative does not supply an additional confession proving that the advice was deliberately designed to deceive him.

title: 埃塔纳乘鹰寻找生育之草
summary: 没有继承人的埃塔纳听从沙马什指引，救起陷坑中的鹰，盼它带自己升天取得生育之草。大地在脚下渐渐缩小，他却因恐惧要求返回，残存泥版没有保全完整结局。
paragraphs: 一只鹰曾与蛇起誓，住在同一棵树上，彼此照顾幼兽，后来却背弃盟约，吃掉蛇的孩子。蛇向太阳神沙马什申诉，依照指引藏入牛尸，趁鹰下来啄食时将它抓住，损伤翅膀并抛进坑里。鹰无法自行脱身，只能祈求援助；与此同时，基什王埃塔纳因为缺少继承人而苦恼。
埃塔纳请求沙马什帮助自己找到生育之草，神便指向困鹰所在。他来到陷坑，给鹰食物，照料它恢复羽翼，换取带自己飞上天空的帮助。鹰让国王贴紧身体，抓住羽毛，然后一层层向上飞去。途中它不断让他俯看下方，原本广大的田野与海水逐渐缩成小块，最后几乎不再可见。
升得越高，埃塔纳越害怕，终于请求停止飞行，返回地面；鹰护着他下降，这次尝试没有替他取回所求。后续残篇又涉及梦境与升天，但泥版缺损使完整收束无法确定。苏美尔王表另记他有儿子巴利赫，却不能用那条王统记录填成他在这篇故事中必然拿到神草的结尾。

en.title: Etana Rides the Eagle Toward Heaven
en.summary: Without an heir, Etana seeks a plant of birth and rescues an eagle at Shamash’s direction. The bird carries him upward, but the shrinking earth terrifies him. He asks to descend, while damaged tablets leave the larger adventure’s conclusion incomplete.
paragraphs: An eagle and a serpent once swore friendship and raised their young in the same tree. The eagle broke the oath by eating the serpent’s offspring. Following Shamash’s advice, the serpent hid inside a bull’s carcass, caught the feeding eagle, damaged its wings, and abandoned it in a pit. Elsewhere, King Etana of Kish suffered because he lacked an heir.

Etana prayed to Shamash for the plant of birth. The god directed him to the trapped eagle, which he fed and helped recover. In return, it agreed to carry him into heaven. Holding tightly to its body and feathers, he rose through successive heights. The eagle repeatedly asked him to look down, where land and sea grew smaller and eventually almost disappeared.

Frightened by the height, Etana asked to return, and the eagle supported his descent. This attempt did not bring back the plant. Further fragments concern dreams and renewed ascent, but damaged tablets prevent a secure reconstruction of the complete ending. The Sumerian King List separately gives Etana a son, Balih; that notice cannot simply supply a missing scene of successful retrieval.
